records.subject: You're in -- let's get Orchard Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Orchard Logistics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:4f680727], [email:c0753ea4]). Fully silent accounts rarely self-start in the remaining 8 days, though Starter setup is light enough that some do.

draft.subject: A first project for Orchard Logistics?
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Checking in on your first week with Wrenfield. Nothing has started on the account yet, so I wanted to make it easy rather than let it sit.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
